blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly important for user-centric applications, yet prior methods mainly adapt dense LLMs, whose polysemantic neurons, each encoding multiple unrelated concepts, hinder localizing the components behind personalization, and thus understanding and controlling it. We propose to personalize Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs, which sparsely route each token to a few specialized experts, reducing polysemanticity and enabling such localization. We adapt three open-weight MoE LLMs on a large-scale personalization dataset and train crosscoders on paired activations of the personalized and non-personalized models to learn interpretable personalized latents, from which we identify the experts encoding distinct personalization features. The personalized MoE LLMs perform competitively with dense LLMs while activating only a fraction of their parameters, exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs with similar active parameters, and, within the same model family, yield personalized latents that are less shared with the non-personalized model. Causal interventions show that these latents suffice to recover the personalized model's behavior and that boosting their associated experts moves the non-personalized model toward it, revealing distinct routing paths for different personalization features.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的个性化对于以用户为中心的应用越来越重要,然而之前的方法主要适应稠密的LLMS,其多语义神经元,每个编码多个不相干的概念,会阻碍个性化背后的组件本地化,从而理解和控制. 我们提议将 " 专家混合 " (MoE)有限责任公司(LLMs)个性化,这些公司很少将每个标志带给几位专门专家,从而减少多聚体抗体,使这种地方化成为可能。 在大型个性化数据集上,我们调整了三个开放量级的MOE LLMs,并在对个性化和非个性化模型的对接激活上培训交叉编码器,以学习可解释的个性化潜质,我们从中识别出将独特的个性化特征编码的专家. 个性化的 MOE LLMs 与稠密的 LLMs 进行竞争,同时激活的参数只有一小部分,其多聚抗性低于具有类似活性参数的稠密的 LLMs ,并且在同一模型家族中产生与非个性化模型较少共享的个性化潜想. 原因干预表明,这些潜在因素足以恢复个性化模型的行为,提升其相关专家将非个性化模型推向它,揭示出不同个性化特征的不同路径.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Personalization of Large Language Models (LLMs) adapts LLMs to user or group preferences ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Due to increasing demand for AI-assisted user-centric applications, Personalization of LLMs has become an important research direction. Most methods use dense LLMs ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , offering little interpretability of localizing important model components encoding distinct personalized features due to the polysemanticity of encoding multiple orthogonal concepts into a single neuron ( Olah et al., 2020 ) . Recent work on developing intrinsically interpretable LLMs suggests that wider, more sparse LLMs enable their neurons to capture more disentangled features and reduce polysemanticity ( Yang et al., 2025b ) . Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) LLMs offer a scalable solution for wider and sparser networks by replacing a dense FFN block in the MLP layer with a set of experts of the same size, using a sparse routing mechanism to select a subset of these experts to process each input token ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ) . This mechanism enables MoE LLMs to offer better interpretability for downstream tasks by achieving lower polysemanticity ( Herbst et al., 2026 ) , where experts encode distinct task-specific features. Motivated by these observations, we utilize MoE LLMs for personalization and subsequent interpretability analysis, addressing research questions covering polysemamticity of MoE LLMs for personalization ( RQ1 , § 6.2 ), identifying distinct personalized features encoded via experts during personalization ( RQ2 , § 6.3 ), and localizing unique routing paths for distinct personalized features ( RQ3 , § 6.4 ).
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)的个性化使LLMs适应用户或群体偏好(Salemi等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2025年b). 由于对AI辅助用户核心应用的需求日益增加,LLMs的个性化已成为重要的研究方向. 大多数方法使用稠密的LLMs(Zhang等人,2025年b),由于将多个正体概念编码成单一神经元的多聚性,使得重要模型组件编码明显个性化特征的本地化几乎没有可解释性(Olah等人,2020年)。 最近关于开发内在可解释的LLMs的研究表明,更宽,更稀疏的LLMs使得其神经元能够捕捉到更分散的特征,并减少多聚苯乙烯(Yang等人,2025年b). Mixture-of-Experts(MoE)LLMs为更宽,更稀疏的网络提供了一个可伸缩的解决方案,在MLP层用一组大小相同的专家取代一个密集的FFN块,使用一条稀疏的路由机制来选择这些专家的子集来处理每个输入符(Shazeer等人,2017年). 这一机制使教育、科学和技术部能够更好地解释下游任务,方法是实现较低的多聚抗体(Herbst等人,2026年),专家们将不同的任务特点编码。 在这些意见的推动下,我们利用教育、教育、青年和体育部来进行个性化和随后的可解释性分析,解决涉及教育、教育和体育部的个性化研究问题(RQ1,第6.2节),确定在个性化期间通过专家编码的独特的个性化特征(RQ2,第6.3节),以及将独特的个性化特征的路径本地化(RQ3,第6.4节)。

blocks.en: Following Bai et al. (2025) on MoE LLMs alignment, we adapt the MoE LLMs towards personalization using a two-stage parameter-efficient finetuning (PEFT) (§ 4.1 ), on a large-scale personalization dataset covering diverse preferences for user groups, MULTIFACETED COLLECTION ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . We then train a sparse autoencoder-based ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Huben et al., 2024 ) architecture crosscoder ( Minder et al., 2025 ) on paired personalized and non-personalized activations to identify interpretable personalization latents. Mapping these latents to experts reveals distinct routing paths associated with personalization. Our proposed method is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 继Bai等人(2025年)对MOE LLMS进行校正后,我们将MOE LLMS改为个性化,采用两个阶段的参数效率微调(PEFT)(§ 4.1),在一个涵盖用户群体不同喜好的大规模个性化数据集上,MULTIFACTED COLLECTION(Lee等人,2024年). 然后,我们培训一种稀疏的自动编码器(Bricken等人,2023年;Huben等人,2024年)建筑交叉编码器(Minder等人,2025年),进行对偶的个性化和非个性化的激活,以查明可解释的个性化潜伏物。 向专家绘制这些潜在信息,可以发现与个性化有关的不同路径。 我们的拟议方法见图1。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on three open-weight instruction-tuned decoder-only MoE LLMs, OLMoE-1B-7B (0125), Qwen3-30B-A3B (2507), and Mixtral-8x7B (v0.1), spanning three personalization benchmarks: MULTIFACETED BENCH ( Lee et al., 2024 ) covering preferences for user groups, and LaMP and LongLaMP benchmarks for per user preference, verifies the scalability of MoE LLMs in personalization by outperforming similar active parameter sized dense LLMs and achieve competitive performance against similar total parameter sized dense LLMs, while utilizing only 20 % ~20\% of the total parameters per token (§ 6.1 ). Furthermore, MoE LLMs enable better learning of crosscoder to identify a high-quality small set of latents (less than 0.25 % 0.25\% of total latents), highly contributing in explaining distinct personalized features encoded during personalization than dense LLMs, verifying lower polysemanticity for personalization (§ 6.2 ). These personalized latents each capture a distinct personalization feature (§ 6.3 ) and map onto a small, stable set of specialized experts (§ 6.4 ), revealing distinct routing paths for personalization in MoE LLMs. Causal interventions further confirm that these latents are sufficient to recover personalized behavior and that the identified experts are necessary for it. Overall, our proposed method offers a principled foundation for understanding and designing more transparent personalized language models.
blocks.zh: 广泛实验了三个开放量级的指令调试解码器(仅限MOE LLMs),OLMOE-1B-7B(0125),Qune3-30B-A3B(2507)和Mixtral-8x7B(v01)三个个性化基准: MULTIFACTED BENCH(Lee等人,2024年)涵盖用户组的偏好,以及LAMP和LongLAMP对每个用户偏好的基准,通过比类似有效参数大小的密集LLMs的性能来验证MOE LLMs在个性化中的可扩展性,并实现与类似总参数大小的密集LLMs的竞争性性能,同时只使用每个令牌总参数的20%~20%(§ 6.1). 此外,教育部的有限责任公司能够更好地学习交叉编码器,从而识别出一套高质量的小的潜在物(低于总潜在物的0.25%),在解释与密集的有限责任公司相比在个性化过程中编码的显著个性化特征方面做出了重大贡献,并核实了个人化的较低多聚体(第6.2节)。 这些个性化潜伏物分别捕捉了独特的个性化特征(第6.3节),并映射到一组小而稳定的专业专家(第6.4节)上,揭示了教育部法学硕士的个人化路径。 原因干预进一步证实,这些潜在因素足以恢复个性化行为,而确定的专家对此是必要的。 总的来说,我们提议的方法为理解和设计更透明的个性化语言模式提供了原则基础。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Personalization of LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.1 有限责任公司的个人化

blocks.en: Methods for aligning LLMs with individual or group preferences ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) condition on retrieved user history or profile summaries ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Richardson et al., 2023 ) , encode personas in the prompt ( Jiang et al., 2024b ) , train per-user adapters ( Tan et al., 2024 ) , learn personalized reward models or merge preference-specific policies ( Cheng et al., 2023 ; Jang et al., 2024 ) , or steer activations toward a user’s style ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Cao et al., 2024 ) . LaMP and LongLaMP ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ) evaluate per-user personalization, while Multifaceted Collection and Bench ( Lee et al., 2024 ) specify group preferences via system messages. These works study dense models as black boxes; we study how sparse MoEs represent personalization.
blocks.zh: 在检索用户历史或概况摘要(Salemi等人,2024年;Richardson等人,2023年)上使有限责任公司与个人或团体偏好(Zhang等人,2025年b)相一致的方法(Jiang等人,2024年b),培训每个用户的适配器 (Tan等人,2024年),学习个性化奖励模式或合并特定优惠政策(Cheng等人,2023年;Jang等人,2024年),或将激活引向用户风格(Zhang等人,2025a年;Cao等人,2024年). LaMP和LongLAMP(Salemi等人,2024年;Kumar等人,2024年)通过系统信息来评价每个用户的个性化,而Mulfaced Collection and Bench(Lee等人,2024年)则通过系统信息来指定群体偏好. 这些作品研究密集模型作为黑盒;我们研究稀疏的MOE如何代表个性化.

blocks.en: 2.2 Mixture-of-Experts LLMs.
blocks.zh: 2.2 专家的混合课程

blocks.en: MoE layers route each token to a few experts, decoupling parameter count from compute ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Zoph et al., 2022 ) , and now underlie strong open models such as Mixtral, OLMoE, and Qwen3 ( Jiang et al., 2024a ; Muennighoff et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) . Analyses of routing report specialization at the level of tokens and syntax rather than domains ( Jiang et al., 2024a ; Xue et al., 2024 ) , semantic routing in controlled settings ( Olson et al., 2025 ) , and language-specific experts identified by contrasting routing frequencies ( Bandarkar et al., 2026 ) . Expert-level specialization can be exploited for adaptation and control: Bai et al. (2025) tune routers to identify context-faithful experts, Li et al. (2026) encourage expert divergence during training, and Fayyaz et al. (2026) steer behavior by (de)activating experts. We adopt a two-stage router-then-expert adaptation for personalization and relate the resulting routing changes to interpretable persona features.
blocks.zh: MOE层路由每条路由给几位专家,将参数数与计算数脱钩(Shazeer等人,2017年;Fedus等人,2022年;Zoph等人,2022年),现为Mixtral,OLMoE,Quen3等强开放模型的基础(Jiang等人,2024a年;Muennighoff等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025a年). 分析路由报告在符号和语法层面而不是域的专业化(Jiang等人,2024a); Xue等人,2024年),受控环境下的语义路由(Olson等人,2025年),通过对比路由频率识别的语言特有专家(Bandarkar等人,2026年). 可以利用专家一级的专门技术进行适应和控制: Bai等人(2025年)的调谐路由器,用于确定符合背景的专家,Li等人(2026年)鼓励专家在培训期间出现分歧,Fayyaz等人(2026年)指导(解除)专家的行为。 我们采用两个阶段的路由器 -- -- 当时是专家 -- -- 的个性化改造,并将由此产生的路由变化与可解释的人物特征联系起来。

blocks.en: Dense-model neurons are polysemantic ( Olah et al., 2020 ) ; sparse autoencoders recover more monosemantic features ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Huben et al., 2024 ) , sparse probing measures how few neurons encode a concept ( Gurnee et al., 2023 ) , and wider, sparser architectures such as MoEs reduce polysemanticity ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Herbst et al., 2026 ) . Crosscoders, trained with BatchTopK ( Bussmann et al., 2024 ) and explained automatically ( Paulo et al., 2025 ) , isolate latents specific to a fine-tuned model and have been applied to chat tuning ( Minder et al., 2025 ) and to MoE–dense comparisons ( Chaudhari et al., 2026 ) . We diff a personalized MoE against its base and map the resulting latents onto the experts that route them.
blocks.zh: Dense-model神经元是多语种的(Olah等人,2020年);稀疏的自动编码器恢复了更多的单语种特征(Bricken等人,2023年;Huben等人,2024年),稀疏的检测方法测定一个概念编码的神经元是多少(Gurnee等人,2023年),更宽广的,稀疏的建筑,如MOEs减少多语种(Yang等人,2025b;Herbst等人,2026年). 与BatchTopK(Bussmann等人,2024年)一起培训并自动解释(Paulo等人,2025年)的交叉编码器将微调模型特有的潜伏物隔离开来,并已应用于聊天调理(Minder等人,2025年)和MoE-dense比较(Chaudhari等人,2026年)。 我们把一个个性化的教育部 根据它的底部, 将由此产生的潜伏 映射到引导它们的专家身上。

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en:
Data and evaluation. We personalize models and train crosscoders on Multifaceted Collection ( Lee et al., 2024 ) . Each example pairs a user query with a system message that encodes a group-level preference across four dimensions (style, background knowledge, informativeness, harmlessness), along with a preference-aligned response generated by GPT-4-Turbo-0125. We evaluate on three benchmarks:
(i) Multifaceted Bench ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , which uses the same system-message format but has no preferences in common with the training set;
(ii) LaMP ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) ; and
(iii) LongLaMP ( Kumar et al., 2024 ) .
LaMP and LongLaMP instead require inferring per-user preferences from interaction history. Following Zhang et al. (2025a) , we use their user splits and omit the email tasks, whose data is not publicly available. We report METEOR and ROUGE-L against the gold responses.

Models and baselines. We study three instruction-tuned MoE LLMs: OLMoE-1B-7B (0125), Qwen3-30B-A3B (2507) and Mixtral-8x7B (v0.1). Each is evaluated without adaptation, after router tuning (RT), and after router and expert tuning (RT+EFT). We compare each MoE model with two dense models, one matching its active and one matching its total parameter count: OLMo-2-1B/7B, Qwen2.5-3B/32B, and Llama-2-13B/70B for Mixtral, following its technical report ( Table 1 ). The dense baselines are evaluated without adaptation and after PEFT on Multifaceted Collection . As a reference, we also report Janus -7B and its ORPO/DPO variants ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , which are fully parameter-fine-tuned on the Multifaceted Collection , indicating the upper bound of performance for LLMs with similar parameter counts.

blocks.en: 6.1 Personalization performance comparison
blocks.zh: 6.1 个性化业绩比较

blocks.en: Across model families and evaluation metrics, MoE LLMs outperform dense LLMs with similar active parameters , and for the Qwen and Mixtral families, they match or exceed dense LLMs with similar total parameters ( Figure 2 ). The per-variant results in Table 2 show the same pattern after personalization: personalized MoE LLMs outperform or match personalized dense LLMs with similar active parameters. Router tuning accounts for most of this gain in Qwen3, whereas expert tuning contributes more in Mixtral. Across benchmarks, personalization yields the largest gains on MULTIFACETED BENCH , which shares the training data’s (MULTIFACETED COLLECTION) form of preference (group-level preferences given via system messages), and smaller gains on LaMP and LongLaMP, which require transferring to per-user preferences inferred from interaction history. Overall, MoE LLMs achieve competitive personalization while activating only a fraction of their parameters, motivating a mechanistic analysis of how their experts encode personalization features.
blocks.zh: 在整个模范家庭和评价指标中,教育部的LLMS的效率超过了具有类似积极参数的密集LMS,对于Quen和Mixtral家庭,它们与具有类似总参数的密集LMS相匹配或超过(图2)。 表2中的单变量结果显示个人化后的相同模式:个性化的MOE LLMS优于或匹配个人化的密集LLMS,具有相似的活动参数. 在Qun3中,路由调节占了这一收益的大部分,而在Mixtral中,专家调节的贡献更大. 在各种基准中,个性化在MULTIFACTED BENCH上获得了最大的收益,后者分享了培训数据(MULTIFACTED COLLECTION)的偏好(通过系统信息给予的集团级偏好)形式,而在LAMP和LongLAMP上也获得了较小的收益,这需要转移到从互动历史推断出来的每个用户偏好。 总的来说,教育、教育和体育部实现了竞争性的个性化,同时只激活了一小部分参数,激发了对其专家如何编码个性化特征的机械分析。

blocks.en: 6.2 RQ1: Do Sparse MoE LLMs offer lower polysemanticity, enabling better disentanglement of personalized features?
blocks.zh: 6.2 RQ1: Do Sparse MOE (英语). LLMS提供较低的多聚抗体,使个性化特征能够更好地分解?

blocks.en:
Polysemanticity. To investigate the polysemanticity behavior of neurons in MoE experts compared to dense LLMs, we use k-sparse probing ( Gurnee et al., 2023 ) . Following Herbst et al. (2026) , we estimate the mean difference of activations between positive and negative tokens per concept and compute the binary classification of a probe considering only the top- k k neurons with the highest activation difference. For our personalization task, we consider the top 5 most frequent sub-dimensions from MULTIFACETED COLLECTION as concepts for each dimension, resulting in 20 independent concepts. For each concept, we take the response tokens (up to 1024 per response, 100 queries) of samples whose system message specifies that sub-dimension as positives, and those of samples specifying a different sub-dimension of the same dimension as negatives (e.g., formal vs. casual under style), giving about 50,000 tokens per class.
Following Herbst et al. (2026) , we only consider tokens routed to the target expert for MoE LLMs and identify the best layer containing the expert achieving the highest classification accuracy on the test split (25% split). For dense LLMs, the best layer is that with the highest-performing MLP. Figure 3 illustrates the variance in k-sparse probe classification accuracy from k = 64 k=64 to k = 1 k=1 for the MoE and dense LLMs with similar active parameters. MoE LLMs outperform dense LLMs with similar active parameters in the balanced accuracy metric, and the performance gap is wider for the same model family (Olmo, Qwen). The gap remains wide at k = 1 k=1 , verifying monosemantic behavior of MoE experts for personalization.

blocks.zh: 6.3 问题2: 将哪些不同的个性化特征分割成一套可解释的概念?

blocks.en: Using the routing-divergence and entropy criteria discussed in § 4.2 , we identify L25, L15, and L6 as the most distinctive layers for Qwen3-30B-A3B (2507), Mixtral-8x7B (v0.1), and OLMoE-1B-7B (0125) respectively, as illustrated in Figures 5 , 12 and 11 . As discussed in § 4.2 , we identify a very small subset (less than 0.25%) of latents with very high ( ≥ 0.9 \geq 0.9 ) decoder norm to reconstruct activations from the personalized MoE LLMs. In particular, we identify (157/65536), (132/131072), (111/65536) personalized latents for Qwen3-30B-A3B (2507), Mixtral-8x7B (v0.1), and OLMoE-1B-7B (0125) respectively, as illustrated in Figures 6 , 14 and 13 .

blocks.en: Interpreting personalized latents. Following Paulo et al. (2025) ; Minder et al. (2025) , we explain each personalized latent with an LLM explainer and evaluate the explanation with an LLM scorer (both Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct). The explainer sees 30 activating examples (the top 20 and 10 weaker ones), each a 40-token window centred on the maximally activating token (32 tokens before, 8 tokens after). The scorer then labels 20 examples as activating and 20 as non-activating, using only the explanation. Figure 8 shows an example: a max-activating latent from Qwen3 is explained as tracking the audience’s level of expertise.
blocks.zh: 解释个性化潜质. 继Paulo等人(2025年);Minder等人(2025年)之后,我们用一个LLM解释器来解释每个个性化潜伏,并以LLM计分器(Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct)来评价解释. 解释者看到30个激活例(前20个和10个较弱的例),每个以最大激活符(前32个令牌,后8个令牌)为中心的40个托肯窗口. 计分者然后将20个实例标注为激活,20个则标注为非激活,只使用解释. 图8举出一个例子:从Quen3到最大激活的潜在值被解释为跟踪受众的专门知识水平。

blocks.en: Most personalized latents encode the requested preference rather than the response: 85% of OLMoE and 82% of Qwen3 latents fire mainly on the system message. Mixtral is the exception, with 41% firing mainly in the response. The models also emphasize different preference dimensions: OLMoE’s latents are dominated by style (52%) and harmlessness (21%), whereas Qwen3’s and Mixtral’s are dominated by background knowledge (45% and 40%). The scorer reaches moderate F1 overall (0.65 OLMoE, 0.63 Qwen3, 0.70 Mixtral; Figure 7 ), rising monotonically across activation bins to 0.81, 0.83 and 0.88 in the top bin, so the explanations best describe strong activations. Overall, the crosscoder decomposes the features that personalization adds to MoE LLMs into a small set of interpretable concepts.
blocks.zh: 多数个性化潜伏器编码了请求的偏好而不是回应:OLMOE的85%和Qwen3的82%潜伏器主要向系统消息开火. 混合是例外,41%的射击主要在反应中进行. 这些模型也强调不同的偏好层面:OLMOE的潜质以风格(52%)和无害(21%)为主,而Qun3和Mixtral的潜质则以背景知识(45%和40 %)为主。 计分器整体达到中度F1(0.65 OLMOE,0.63 Qun3,0.70 Mixtral;图7),单调跨越激活箱上升至顶端的0.81,0.83和0.88,因此解释最能描述强激活. 总的来说,交叉编码器将个人化给MOE LLMs添加的特性分解为一小组可解释的概念.

blocks.en: 6.4 RQ3: How are different experts in MoE uniquely aligned with different personalized features?
blocks.zh: 6.4 RQ3: (中文(简体) ). 教育部的不同专家如何与不同的个性化特征形成独特的联系?

blocks.en: To test whether distinct personalization features map to different experts, we evaluate the distinctiveness and stability of latent–expert mappings (see § 4.2 ). As illustrated in Figure 9 , for each latent, we select the optimal 400 examples and restrict it to route towards one expert every layer for the Qwen3-30B-A3B (2507). For this setting, we achieve very high stability with S S of 0.81, verifying that under repeated sampling over those 400 examples, most of the activating examples are routed towards a specialized expert. To validate whether the routing is heavily influenced by a dominant expert, we measure the distinctiveness and a very high D D of 0.94, which verifies that a different set of examples activated by different latents is routed to their respective experts. Overall, experts in MoE LLMs encode distinct personalized features, verifying lower polysemanticity for personalization.
blocks.zh: 为了检验个人化特征是否向不同的专家映射,我们评价潜在专家绘图的独特性和稳定性(见第4.2节)。 如图9所示,我们为每一个潜在者选择400个最佳实例,并限制其为Qune3-30B-A3B(2507)的每层向一位专家行驶。 在这种背景下,我们以0.81的S实现高度稳定,核实在反复取样的400个实例中,大多数激活实例都指向专业专家。 为了证实路线是否受到主导专家的很大影响,我们测量了独特性和非常高的D值0.94,这证明不同的潜伏物所激活的一组不同的例子被传递给各自的专家。 总的来说,教育部法学硕士课程的专家对明显的个性化特征进行了编码,验证了较低程度的多元性,以便实现个性化。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We presented, to our knowledge, the first mechanistic study of personalization in MoE LLMs. Combining a two-stage router-and-expert adaptation for personalization with crosscoder-based interpretability analysis for personalization mechanism shows: (1) MoE LLMs achieve competitive personalization performance than dense LLMs by utilizing only ∼ 20 % \sim 20\% of total parameters. (2) MoE LLMs exhibit lower polysemanticity than dense LLMs for personalization and they enable better interpretability of encoded personalization features via crosscoder than dense LLMs. (3) MoE encodes distinct personalization features via different routing paths, enabling better localization and subsequent intervention for controlled personalization.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,我们在教育部法学硕士中介绍了关于个性化的第一份机械研究。 结合两个阶段的路由器和专家的个性化改造与个人化机制的跨编码解释性分析显示: (1) MOE LLMS通过使用总参数的20%\sim 20\\%来实现竞争性个性化表现,而不是密集的LLMS. (2) 与密集的LLMs相比,MOE LLMs在个人化方面呈现出较低的多聚抗性,它们使得通过交叉编码器对编码的个性化特征的可解释性比密集的LLMs更好。 (3)教育部通过不同的路径编码了独特的个性化特征,从而能够更好地本地化,并随后进行干预以控制个人化.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Models and comparisons. We study three open MoE families and analyze one layer per model, selected by routing divergence. Personalization features may also arise at other layers, and our conclusions may not transfer to other MoE designs (e.g., shared experts or fine-grained expert segmentation). The dense counterparts are matched by active or total parameter count, but differ in pre-training data and
recipes, so architectural effects cannot be fully separated from training differences.
blocks.zh:
模型与比较. 我们研究三个开放的教育部家庭,分析每个模型的一层,通过路由差异来选择。 个性化特征也可能出现在其他层面,我们的结论可能不会转移到其他的教育部设计(例如共享专家或精细的分化专家). 密集的对等方有主动参数或总参数数的匹配,但培训前数据和
配方,因此建筑效果不能与培训差异完全分开.

blocks.en: Data and notion of persona. Multifaceted-Collection describes preferences through synthetic system messages over four dimensions, with categorical, long-tailed subdimension labels. This captures group-level preferences rather than individual users, and our experiments are limited to English. Personalization signals in real user histories may be noisier and more entangled than in this controlled setting.
blocks.zh: 数据和人的概念a。 多面-收缩描述通过合成系统信息在四个维度上的偏好,带有绝对的,长尾的子化标签. 这捕捉到集团级的偏好,而不是个人用户,我们的实验仅限于英语. 真实用户历史中的个性化信号可能比在这种受控的设置中更噪声和缠绕.

blocks.en: Crosscoder fidelity. Crosscoders reconstruct activations imperfectly, and reconstruction quality varies across models (with fractions of variance explained of 0.80 0.80 for OLMoE, 0.74 0.74 for Qwen3-30B-A3B, and 0.65 0.65 for Mixtral, whose activations have much larger magnitudes and heavier tails). Information in the reconstruction error is invisible to our latent-level analyses, and the set of personalized latents depends on the decoder-norm threshold. BatchTopK training and latent scaling mitigate known sparsity artifacts ( Minder et al., 2025 ) , but do not rule them out entirely.
blocks.zh: 十字形的忠诚。 交叉编码器重建激活不完美,重建质量因型号而异(其中差异分数解释为OLMOE0.800.80,Qune3-30B-A3B0.74,Mixtral0.650.65,其激活量大得多,尾巴更重). 重建错误中的信息对于我们潜在的水平分析是看不见的,而一组个性化的潜伏取决于解码器-规范阈值. 批次 TopK培训和潜在缩放减轻了已知的垃圾处理文物(Minder等人,2025年),但并不完全排除它们。

blocks.en: Probing. Persona concepts are properties of whole responses, whereas sparse probing labels individual tokens, thereby introducing label noise and lowering absolute scores across all models. Selecting the best of many components favors MoE models, which have more candidates (layers × \times experts); we mitigate this by selecting on test data and reporting test scores, but selection effects may remain, particularly for k = 1 k=1 . Probes measure whether a concept is decodable, not whether the model uses it.
blocks.zh: 探经. Persona概念是整个响应的属性,而稀疏的检测标记是单个的符号,从而引入标签噪声,降低所有模型的绝对分数. 从许多组件中选择最好的,倾向于MOE模型,这些模型拥有更多的候选者(层×\times 专家);我们通过在测试数据上选择和报告测试分数来缓解这种情况,但选择效果可能依然存在,特别是对于k=1k=1. 探测器测量一个概念是否可解码,而不是模型是否使用.

blocks.en: Expert attribution and causality. Expert sets are derived from routing frequencies at firing tokens and are therefore correlational; they depend on the number of examples, the selection rule, and the background routing rate, and their stability is moderate.
blocks.zh: 专家归属和因果关系。 专家集是从发射信物的路由频率衍生出来的,因此具有相关性;它们取决于实例的数量,选择规则,以及背景的路由率,它们的稳定性是中等的.

blocks.en:
Evaluation of generation. ROUGE-L and METEOR measure overlap with reference responses and are imperfect proxies for personalization: a response can satisfy a preference while diverging from the reference wording, as our steering results illustrate. Sampling-based generation adds variance. Automated explanations rely on an LLM explainer and scorer (Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct), whose own biases may shape the
descriptions.
blocks.zh:
世代评价. ROUGE-L和METEOR措施与参考答复重叠,是个人化的不完善代词:如我们的指导结果所示,反应可以满足偏好,同时与参考措词不同。 基于抽样的生成增加了差异。 自动解释依赖于LLM解释器和计分器(Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct),后者本身的偏差可能会影响该程序。

blocks.en: B.1.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.1.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We utilize LoRA-PEFT for both router tuning and personalized experts tuning of MoE models and personalization of dense LLMs. We only update the MLP weights for both MoE and dense LLMs. To train the crosscoder, we utilize the BatchTopK crosscoder with L0 and an expansion factor of 32 for all three MoE LLMs, using paired activations collected from the residual MLP contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们利用LORA-PEFT对路由器进行调试,对MOE模型进行个性化的专家进行调试,并对密集的LLMs进行个性化. 我们只更新教育部和LLMs的 MLP 重量。 为了训练交叉编码器,我们使用带L0的BatchTopK交叉编码器,以及所有三个MOE LLMs的32扩展系数,使用从剩余MLP贡献中收集的对联激活.
